claims.title: Nominal catalytic gaps, necessary robust tolerance and a complete one-species baseline

quoted_fields.interface: Original fixed one-species R={0->X,X->0}, actual class N, positive ordinary rational lambda, integer n0>=0 and rational0<epsilon<1. Necessity permits ANY finite allowed parallel catalyst copies w->w+1 and w+1->w, including positive original channels, with exact nominal Poisson law. Robust coefficient errors are arbitrary independent fixed relative errors within[-delta,delta]; the coherent extremal birth/death choice is one allowed case.
quoted_fields.failure: Complete one-species tolerance necessity and positive unaugmented baseline only. The universal delta restriction is compatible with the full problem numerical polynomial W budget and is NOT a negative answer. General fixed weakly reversible networks, arbitrary catalytic-clock perturbations and their recurrence/law/activity/tolerance interfaces remain OPEN. Prior full general NOMINAL exact-law gap construction and original-rate counterexamples retain distinct scopes; a nominal gap alone supplies no robust theorem. Source/access/transfer/resource holds unchanged; no novelty, physical advantage or independent validation claim.
